mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level compresses the risk-free rate and reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate decline below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST > 650) and retail sales (RSAFS > 360000) indicates robust consumer demand that accelerates economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST > 650 and RSAFS > 360000, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 100 signals economic contraction risk, triggering Fed policy tightening that reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 13200) indicates sustained economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 13200, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 3.0% signals accelerating inflation that forces the Fed to implement rate hikes, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS > 100) and unemployment decline (UNRATE < 5.0) indicate a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 100 and UNRATE < 5.0, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 100 signals weakening economic activity that increases recession probability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
